prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Draw ONE canonical full-body Candy Troll for American Girl Doll Race.
Input image 1 is a STYLE AND ANATOMY reference only: keep the game's hunched chunky troll silhouette, broad shoulders, long heavy arms, big empty hands and squat legs, but transform the entire creature into CANDY. Input image 2 is the Candy Land racetrack PALETTE AND MATERIAL reference.
Design: body made of layered glossy chewy pink and strawberry-red candy, rounded translucent gumdrop shoulders, pale marshmallow belly, short twisted licorice tufts, candy-corn teeth in a crooked grumpy grin, small bright candy-button eyes under thick candy brows. Peppermint swirl accents embedded sparingly in shoulders/knees, chunky candy fingers and broad sturdy candy feet. Everything is edible confectionery, no flesh or fabric, no held weapon or props. Integrate the candy ingredients into a cohesive troll body rather than a pile of unrelated sweets. Charming mischievous kid-friendly antagonist, comically grumpy, not frightening. Strong readable shape at small game size.
Style: tactile miniature, painted slightly photoreal storybook game art with rich material detail, soft dimensional shading, matching existing race art. Full body in a relaxed neutral standing hunch, three-quarter side view facing RIGHT; both hands visible and empty, feet on one baseline. Centered single character with generous transparent margins, entire hair/hands/feet visible. Actual transparent background, no environment, no floor or cast shadow, no text, no border, no labels. This is a single canonical drawing, NOT an animation sheet.
status: Canonical concept only; not registered in gameplay
